title: Prove the exact all-chart direct replacement cost of P104 paid slot 88
body:
On the #7786 rational word, there is an exact two-send replacement for paid slots 95914 and 88. Send the original owner coordinate from chart 11 to receiver 127 and a live copy from chart 138 to 127. The verifier checks the resulting operator on all 1,289 independent coordinates and all 1,289 outputs.

The two sends have grades 8 and 1. Four sparse rational inputs prove that **p(8) + p(1) is the minimum over all 1,103 donor charts** for any nonnegative, nondecreasing concave grade tariff with p(0)=0. Donors may access all their surviving stock and the receiver may use arbitrary free local decoding. The attaining construction obeys the original chronology. With the productive terms and other transfers fixed, it costs **94.666202960674… more signed units** across 48 calls than the incumbent grade-2 and grade-5 transfers at the target κ. This closes the direct repair family. Cooperative rerouting and changes to surviving ingress remain open.

The four registered Python 3.12 checks passed locally and from a read-only Git-free export, including directed rational bounds on price. Credit goes to Clear1nsight for the #7786 source and #7795 handoff and to Ali Romman for the underlying #7776 tariff and supplier. Parallel PR #7804 treats adjoint chart 3.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-receiver-single-send
```

Committed bytes, source history, executable modes and export inventory passed the repository checks. Prepared by apoursh with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The selected conditional multiplication exponent remains unchanged.
